summary: Read two singly linked chains. Each node stores an integer and one arrow to its successor. The chains may meet at a node and then share the following tail. Find the earliest node that both chains reach and write that node. If they never share a node, write null. After the answer is produced, every arrow must still match the chains you started with. No node anywhere leads back into a loop, so you can rely on that fact while reading the chains. Prefer work that grows with the number of nodes and extra memory that stays fixed.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
